scenes.setting: The Sun Brooch changes hands: instant desert heat, a headful of Sun-domain spells (Holy Light, Holy Water, Fire of Light, Holy Oath…), 2000 pounds counted thrice — and Eye of Wisdom sends the big spender out first, safe from greedy eyes
scenes.text_anchor: he saw the sky filled with dancing dots of pure gold light

scenes.setting: In the hired carriage Sharron confirms preparations are done — and takes Klein's odd request to have Kaspars bury a box of explosives across the battlefield: 'I just want to put on some fireworks'
scenes.text_anchor: “I just want to put on some fireworks.”

scenes.setting: Thursday: Mike Joseph invites himself to toast and milk, hiring protection for a sponsored exposé of East Borough — answer tomorrow; then a note materializes on the coffee table: 'Tonight at 10 o'clock. The back door of Bravehearts Bar.'
scenes.text_anchor: “Tonight at 10 o'clock. We'll meet at the back door of Bravehearts Bar.”
